GST Deputy Commissioner Arrested for Taking Bribe in Varanasi

Ambika Singh, a GST Deputy Commissioner in Varanasi, was apprehended by the Vigilance Department while accepting a bribe of ₹50,000. The arrest occurred during the act of receiving the payment. This incident highlights ongoing efforts to combat corruption within government departments.
